name: app-in-hand-close-up-with-huge-text-and-floating-cards-lime-black
title: Tilted hand-held app with 'Good morning, Alex' and floating black reward and status chips
whatItIs: A photograph of a hand holding a tilted phone against a blurred dark sweater, the screen showing a huge greeting, a black map with a lime route and a 'Book a ride' lime bar. Black chips for rewards and safety status float outside, with a white headline below where the middle phrase is lime.
whatItMeans: Real and premium; the photo grounds the UI in everyday life.
techniques: Shoot the device in a real hand with soft blur.
Float black chips outside the screen for key facts.
Colour the middle of a big statement lime.
Fade the photo to black under the text.

vocabulary.definition: A UI shown in a real setting.
A UI card placed outside the device.
A big personalised hello as the screen's headline.
